Hi Laura / Erik,

Thanks again for taking time this morning to walk through EnterpriseCorp's use case for LLM inference. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use: customer support and claims triage across EU & US customers.
- Data sensitivity: PII + limited PHI in claims workflows (HIPAA implications).
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 (scope & Type II status), GDPR data processing agreements, and vendor questionnaire for security review.
- Longer-term: potential interest in ISO 27001 and expanding SOC scope to include production inference pipelines.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Your team to confirm current SOC 2 status (Type I/II, scope, auditor).
2) We'll send our vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) and a short pre-read on our data flows and encryption.
3) Propose a technical security review with your security team (30–45 mins) next week to walk architecture and key controls.
4) Discuss timeline for ISO 27001 / SOC scope expansion assessment (rough estimate: 6–8 weeks planning + audit prep depending on scope).

I'm attaching the VSQ and a short architecture diagram for your security team to review. Please let me know who on your side should own the VSQ and a couple of times that work for the technical review.

Thanks, looking forward to keeping momentum.
